goal: [specialist:config_builder] Benchmark MongoDB against PostgreSQL for bulk document insert performance at one million documents. Report which is faster and by how much.

name: list_categories
list_templates
get_template
result:
{
  "name": "transport_adbc_scale",
  "content": "meta:
  name: "Connectivity cost at scale: psycopg vs ADBC vs connectorx to 10M (cross-over)"
  tier: exploratory
  description: >
    Scale extension of the transport experiment (capsule 139340a3) to 10M rows,
    to test whether the primitive cross-over holds. At 100K/1M, Arrow carried a
    fixed overhead that LOST on primitives (ADBC 1.68x slower @100K -> ~tied @1M)
    while winning on nested. Question: does Arrow win on primitives at 10M as the
    fixed overhead amortizes, or not? This is TRANSPORT (trivial SELECT *), not
    query execution. Cold-cache, sealed. NOTE: psycopg row-fetch of nested at 10M
    may be very slow/heavy (materializing ~10M Python objects) — that collapse is
    itself a finding.
dataset:
  source: sql_benchmarks.plugins.data_sources.declarative_gen
  seed: 42
  tables:
    wide:
      rows: rows
      columns:
        - {name: id, provider: sequence, primary_key: true}
        - {name: n, provider: random_int, min_value: 0, max_value: 1000}
        - {name: payload, provider: json_blob, type: jsonb}
        - {name: tags, provider: int_array, length: 3, type: "integer[]"}
definitions:
  rows:
    small:  100_000
    medium: 1_000_000
    large:  10_000_000
execution:
  test_suite: transport
  engines:
    - postgres_transport
  replication: 3
  matrix:
    rows:
      - small
      - medium
      - large
    postgres_transport.client:
      - psycopg
      - adbc
      - connectorx
",
  "path": "queue/transport_adbc_scale.yaml"
}

meta:
  name: "Bulk document insert performance: PostgreSQL"
  tier: user-request
  description: >
    Benchmark bulk document insert performance in PostgreSQL at one million documents.
    This experiment measures the performance of inserting 1 million JSON documents
    into a PostgreSQL table using different transport clients.
dataset:
  source: sql_benchmarks.plugins.data_sources.declarative_gen
  seed: 42
  tables:
    docs:
      rows: rows
      columns:
        - {name: id, provider: sequence, primary_key: true}
        - {name: doc, provider: json_blob, type: jsonb}
definitions:
  rows:
    medium: 1_000_000
execution:
  test_suite: transport
  engines:
    - postgres_transport
  replication: 3
  matrix:
    rows:
      - medium
    postgres_transport.client:
      - psycopg
      - adbc
      - connectorx
